name: Linux runtime (Ubuntu 26.04 LTS)
note: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS arm64 runtime for DroidDeck, built by tools/ubuntu in Droid-Deck/DroidDeck (PR #1733); rc2 adds libxcb-keysyms1 so the DD-Turnip driver loads (PR #1773). Its Kubuntu Plasma desktop pack is ubuntu-r1-rc2-desktop.tar.zst in the same release, named inside the runtime at usr/share/droiddeck/desktop-pack.json. Release candidate: only test builds of PR #1733 read this file.
